data.name: Azraa
data.gender_notes: Azraa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Slender, Graceful, Subtle, Delicate, Tender. The name Azraa carries the meaning “gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Azraa usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a gentle and beautiful soul, who is loved by Allah and radiates kindness and compassion to others.
data.etymology: Azraa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azraa total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: عزراء
in_arabic.meaning: عزراء تعني الفتاة الحميدة أو الفتاة الطيبة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عزراء مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-ز-ر' والذي يعني القوة والمساعدة. في اللغة العربية، عزراء تعني الفتاة الحميدة أو الفتاة الطيبة التي تتمتع بقوة وخصال حميدة. كما ورد في بعض التفاسير أن اسم عزراء يرتبط بمعاني العزة والكرامة.

in_urdu.name: عزراء
in_urdu.meaning: عزراء یعنی نیک خصلت لڑکی یا خوب صورت لڑکی
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزراء نام عربی جڑ 'ع-ز-ر' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے طاقت اور مدد۔ اردو میں، عزراء کا مطلب ہے نیک خصلت لڑکی یا خوب صورت لڑکی جس میں طاقت اور حمیدہ صفات ہوں۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، یہ نام عزت اور کرامت کے معانی سے بھی وابستہ ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अزرा
in_hindi.meaning: अزرा का अर्थ है अच्छी ख़ासियत वाली लड़की या सुंदर लड़की
in_hindi.long_meaning: अजऱा नाम अरबी मूल 'ع-ز-ر' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति और सहायता। हिंदी में, अजऱा का अर्थ है अच्छी ख़ासियत वाली लड़की या सुंदर लड़की जिसमें शक्ति और अच्छी विशेषताएं हों। भारतीय मुस्लिम परंपरा में, यह नाम सम्मान और गरिमा के अर्थों से जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: عزراء
in_pashto.meaning: عزراء د ښې ځانګړتیا لرونکې نجلۍ یا ښکلې نجلۍ معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: عزراء نوم د عربي ريښې 'ع-ز-ر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې ځواک او مرسته ده. په پښتو کې، عزراء د ښې ځانګړتیا لرونکې نجلۍ یا ښکلې نجلۍ معنی چې په کې ځواک او ښې ځانګړتیاوې لري. د افغان او پښتون دود کې، دا نوم د عزت او کرامت د معنيو سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Azraa
in_english.meaning: Azraa means a girl with good character or a beautiful girl
in_english.long_meaning: The name Azraa is derived from the Arabic root 'ع-ز-ر' which signifies strength and assistance. In Islamic tradition, Azraa refers to a girl with good character or a beautiful girl possessing inner strength and noble qualities. The name is associated with meanings of dignity and honor, reflecting positive personality traits.

In many Muslim cultures, names are given based on their profound meanings and the virtues they represent. The name Azraa is particularly beautiful and can be used for both boys and girls, reflecting the softness, strength, and elegance inherent in the Islamic tradition. The name evokes images of slender and delicate individuals, who carry themselves with poise and subtle grace.

In Islam, one of the essential virtues is "mercy" towards other human beings and all creation. The name Azraa encourages individuals to cultivate these qualities, making their interactions with others deeply compassionate, loving, and humanizing. It also signifies a delicate and subtle connection to the divine, a reminder of the intricacy and subtlety of the spiritual path, which leads towards a peaceful, harmonious, and emotionally enriching life.
